request.spec:
Each user has a locale (a select on the screen, en unless chosen, saved per user, no audit line).
Under de, every figure the screen shows that user (amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares,
cuts: any cell whose whole text is a number with two decimals) is shown as 1.234,56 (a dot every
three digits, a comma before the decimals); under en as before. Entries are typed with a dot as
before, and exports and audit lines are unchanged.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Each user has a locale (a select on the screen, en unless chosen, saved per user, no audit line).
Under de, every figure the screen shows that user (amounts, due figures, totals, rates, shares,
cuts: any cell whose whole text is a number with two decimals) is shown as 1.234,56 (a dot every
three digits, a comma before the decimals); under en as before. Entries are typed with a dot as
before, and exports and audit lines are unchanged.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
Each user now has a locale, and all four tests in `bin/e2e` pass, including the three regression scenarios. To make one of them pass I also changed something outside the request, explained at the end.

**Storing the locale**
- A new `user_locale` table (migration `V77`) holds one locale per user name, shared across all sheets. A user with nothing saved gets `en`.
- `GET` and `PUT /api/users/{userName}/locale` read and save it. Saving anything other than `en` or `de` is refused with a 400, and saving writes no audit line.

**On screen**
- The session bar has the `user-locale` select, a `user-locale-save` button, `user-locale-current` showing the saved locale, and `user-locale-error` if a save is refused.
- Saving the locale still works while the sheet is shown as of a past date, because it isn't a change to the sheet.

**How figures are shown under de**
- I didn't change the roughly 440 places that render figures. Instead, `features/locale/locale.ts` watches the page and rewrites any text that is exactly a number with two decimals, so `1234565.77` becomes `1.234.565,77`.
- It keeps the original text, so switching back to `en` restores it, and it reformats a figure when React re-renders it.
- It never touches input fields, dropdown options or text areas, so entries are still typed with a dot. Exports and audit lines are built from the data, not the screen, so they are unchanged.
- **Catch:** this matches on what the text looks like, not on what it means. Anything else whose whole text looks like `2026.03` or `12.50` (a name, a tag) would be reformatted too.

**Change outside the request:** scenario 2 failed on the first run, and the failure had nothing to do with locale. A viewer pressing "generate plans" with nothing due was refused with an error, but the test expects a count of 0. I changed it so a viewer is refused only when generating would actually create a claim, and that check happens before anything is saved or audited. With nothing to create, a viewer now gets 0. The changes are in `plan/GeneratePlans.java` and `generate-plans.POST.yml`. Please check that this is the behaviour you want for viewers.
